questions.stem: What type of image does a diverging (concave) lens always produce?
questions.explanation: A diverging (concave) lens always produces a virtual, upright, and diminished image regardless of where the object is placed. The image appears on the same side of the lens as the object.

questions.stem: A converging lens has a focal length of 10 cm. What is its power?
questions.explanation: Power = 1 / focal length (in metres). Here, focal length = 10 cm = 0.1 m. Power = 1 / 0.1 = 10 D (dioptres). A positive power indicates a converging lens.
